newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica money mkt shortage at 6.28 bln rand Mon. [CORRECTED 09:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: SAfrica money mkt shortage at 6.28 bln rand Mon. [CORRECTED 09:55 GMT]

text.p: The South African Reserve Bank said Monday's money market shortage rose to 6.284 billion rand from 5.781 billion rand on Saturday.
(Corrects figure in title and text from 6.777 bln rand. Correction provided by central bank).
The bank said an announcement earlier on Tuesday of a 6.777 billion rand shortage was incorrect.
A central bank spokesman said a local bank had made an error in figures contributing to the daily total.
Monday's shortage was up from Saturday's 5.781 billion rand shortage, the Reserve Bank said.
